purpose: Record local source-context review for all 24 C2-LT-B4 source extraction rows. This register verifies structural readiness for independent fresh review while preserving duplicate consensus lineage, no-abstract fulltext needs, blocked uses, reviewed-artifact blocks and model-admission blocks.

scope.selectionRule: Review all C2-LT-B4 source extraction rows after field-level extraction, without promoting any row to reviewed artifact fill or calibrated model admission.
currentLimitations: This is local structural review only and is not independent fresh review.
Rows with no abstract require manual fulltext/source-resolution review before bounded fresh-review evidence use.
The duplicate consensus lineage row must be resolved before evidence counting and cannot be treated as independent support.
No row admits calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice, individual death-date output or domain-claim upgrade.
Reviewed artifacts remain blocked until independent fresh review and source-resolution gates complete.

localReviewChecks: Every reviewed task is present in the C2-LT-B4 source extraction queue.
Every reviewed task has a completed extraction row in the C2-LT-B4 source extraction register.
Every extraction row preserves exact claim use, endpoint, population or setting, mechanism or effect, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position.
Every extraction row keeps model admission blocked and prohibited uses complete.
Every local domain path exists and exposes README.md and AGENTS.md.
Rows with no-abstract/fulltext needs or duplicate consensus lineage are explicitly preserved in sourceResolutionFindings.
The register routes non-issue rows to independent fresh review and issue rows to source-resolution/manual-fulltext review before Source Card promotion.

nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This register does not complete any reviewed Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade-check artifact.
This register does not repair no-abstract/fulltext gaps or duplicate consensus lineage; it records them for source-resolution review.
This register does not validate external source truth, clinical recommendations, intervention effects, calibrated risks or individual prognosis.
This register does not authorize model admission, domain-claim upgrade, intervention ranking, individual advice or individual death-date output.
